headline.purpose: The screen name, left aligned. Home uses it for Keep.

title.purpose: The note card title, two lines at most.

body.purpose: Composer fields and the unknown-route message.

label.purpose: Button labels. Note body copy uses the same size at weight 400.

shadows.name: resting-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards, inputs, and filled buttons at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default filled action. Ink on soft paper, 40px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(0 0% 9%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: hsl(0 0% 9% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Large Button
components.description: The composer Close control. Same primary colours at 44px.
components.css: .ds-btn-large { background: hsl(0 0% 9%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-large:hover, .ds-btn-large:active { background: hsl(0 0% 9% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-large:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: hsl(0 0% 96.1%); color: hsl(0 0% 9%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: hsl(0 0% 96.1% / 0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Paper fill with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 89.8%); border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:active { background: hsl(0 0% 96.1%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Signal red. The only hue in the system. Not used on a shipping screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: hsl(0 84.2% 60.2%); color: hsl(0 0% 100%); height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover, .ds-btn-destructive:active { background: hsl(0 84.2% 60.2% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 84.2% 60.2% / 0.2); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line field. Placeholder stays on graphite.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 240px; height: 40px; padding: 4px 12px; background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); border: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 89.8%); border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(0 0% 45.1%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(0 0% 63%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Textarea
components.description: The note body. Grows with the sheet.
components.css: .ds-textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 240px; min-height: 96px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); border: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 89.8%); border-radius: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: hsl(0 0% 45.1%); } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(0 0% 63%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

components.name: Note Card
components.description: A saved note. Title up to two lines, body up to eight.
components.css: .ds-note { width: 160px; padding: 12px; background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); border: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 89.8%); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-note p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Composer Trigger
components.description: Opens the note sheet from home.
components.css: .ds-trigger { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(0 0% 45.1%); border: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 89.8%); border-radius: 10px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25rem; text-align: left; } .ds-trigger:hover, .ds-trigger:active { background: hsl(0 0% 96.1%); } .ds-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(0 0% 63% / 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
Assumption: this name was not chosen in an interview. It describes the interface that is already shipping. Home is a white (or near-black) index. Each note is a small card. The words on the card are the colour. Chrome stays out of the way.

The system is the React Native Reusables new-york preset on a neutral base: achromatic surfaces, a hairline border, and a shadow so light it barely lifts the card. Density is comfortable on a phone, not compact. The only strong weight is the screen title. Everything else is body or label.

Dark mode is the same structure with the surfaces inverted, not a second palette. A fluent iPhone user should recognise a large title, a sheet for writing, and safe areas. The controls are the shared button and field components, not a custom iOS kit.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome surfaces. Hue is reserved for a destructive action.
The note's own words are the card. No icon, no metadata row, no colour chip.
Hairline borders do the separating. Shadows stay at the smallest step.
One large left-aligned title per top-level screen.
Writing happens in a sheet. Leaving the sheet is what saves.

rules.name: The One Chromatic Rule
rules.body: Signal red (`colors.signal` in light, `colors.night-signal` in dark) is the only hue. It is the destructive button. It is not a link colour, a pin, or a note background.

rules.name: The Left Title Rule
rules.body: The screen name sits on the left, at the headline size above. Do not center it, and do not put a second line above it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A 1px border is the separator. Do not stack a second shadow style, and do not drop the border in favour of a larger shadow.

dos: Do keep body and secondary text on graphite or night graphite. Those steps clear ordinary reading contrast on paper and on soft ink.
Do give every control at least 44px of height. The composer trigger and Close already do.
Do save when the sheet dismisses, and keep the grabber. The sheet is the composer.
Do follow the system appearance. Light and dark are both first-class.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue, a gradient, a glass blur, or a display webfont. The index stays quiet.
Don't colour a note with a Keep palette color until that colour is a token in this file.
Don't center the screen title or add a kicker above it.
Don't replace the masonry card with an icon-and-heading tile. The card's content is the note.
Don't invent a tab bar for a single index.
